pages.title: Soak and Scrape
pages.text: Seal one Raw Hide with 250 mB water for 2400 ticks, or two minutes. Craft the resulting Soaked Hide with a primitive knife for Scraped Hide, using knife durability. Raw Hide cannot skip straight to tanning.

pages.title: Brew Tannin
pages.text: Seal four Tree Bark with 1000 mB water for 6000 ticks, or five minutes. The output is 1000 mB Tannin Solution in the separate output tank. Drain it with a bucket before reusing the barrel for another fluid batch.

pages.title: Tan and Dry
pages.text: Seal one Scraped Hide with 250 mB Tannin Solution for 12000 ticks, or ten minutes, to get Tannin-Soaked Hide. Smelt it for 600 ticks to dry into Leather. Raw, soaked, scraped, and tanned hide are distinct stages.

pages.title: Heavy Leather
pages.text: Seal two Leather with 500 mB Tannin Solution for 12000 ticks to make one Heavy Leather. This is required by Bellows. A bucket carries 1000 mB, while these barrel recipes consume smaller portions.
